# api_v1 reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-sqlview/api/api_v1.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`ew sql` and the rule packs read a project through the read-only SQL views `api_v1_*` ([doc 17 §6](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#6-read-only-sql-projection)); `ew sql schema` prints the same list. The contract's status is **preview**: until the 1.0 freeze views and columns may still be added, and within v1 none is removed, renamed or retyped (ADR-0017). A column marked as a Preview addition goes beyond the documented key columns of doc 17 §6.1. This reference lists the 13 views, from the snapshot [`crates/ew-sqlview/api/api_v1.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/crates/ew-sqlview/api/api_v1.json).

| View | One row per | Columns |
|---|---|---|
| [`api_v1_bom_assembly`](#api_v1_bom_assembly) | bill-of-materials row in assembly mode (doc 20 §14.2), in list order | 15 |
| [`api_v1_bom_component`](#api_v1_bom_component) | bill-of-materials row in component mode (doc 20 §14.1), in list order | 13 |
| [`api_v1_bond`](#api_v1_bond) | bond between two potentials (doc 08 §3.7) | 10 |
| [`api_v1_cable`](#api_v1_cable) | cable | 14 |
| [`api_v1_conductor`](#api_v1_conductor) | conductor of a cable | 11 |
| [`api_v1_device`](#api_v1_device) | device (strips, terminals and cables included) | 23 |
| [`api_v1_function`](#api_v1_function) | function (interruption points included) | 12 |
| [`api_v1_message`](#api_v1_message) | finding of the projection's check run (open and waived) | 14 |
| [`api_v1_meta`](#api_v1_meta) | the projection (one row) | 9 |
| [`api_v1_page`](#api_v1_page) | page in page order, dividers and generated report pages included | 17 |
| [`api_v1_potential`](#api_v1_potential) | potential (doc 08 §3) | 19 |
| [`api_v1_terminal`](#api_v1_terminal) | terminal | 19 |
| [`api_v1_wire`](#api_v1_wire) | physical wire or terminal bridge (doc 08 §3.8, §6.5) | 47 |

## `api_v1_bom_assembly`

One row per bill-of-materials row in assembly mode (doc 20 §14.2), in list order.

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | INTEGER | the 1-based position within its group |  |
| `configured` | INTEGER | 1 for a configured product (printed A1, A2, …) | yes |
| `part_id` | TEXT | the part copy |  |
| `variant` | TEXT | the variant key; NULL without one | yes |
| `manufacturer` | TEXT | the manufacturer as printed |  |
| `part_number` | TEXT | the part number (the order code for a configured product) |  |
| `type` | TEXT | the type designation; NULL without one |  |
| `description` | TEXT | the part description, neutral text |  |
| `description_ml` | TEXT | the part description, JSON of all languages | yes |
| `quantity` | TEXT | the summed quantity, exact decimal text |  |
| `unit` | TEXT | the order unit |  |
| `tags` | TEXT | the devices with this part, JSON array of list-form tags in natural order |  |
| `folios` | TEXT | the folios of those devices' main representations, JSON array in page order |  |
| `assembly_tag` | TEXT | the list-form tag of the configured product's head device when the row has exactly one; NULL otherwise (not derived for several heads yet) |  |
| `level` | INTEGER | the level in the assembly tree; NULL until assembly levels are derived |  |

## `api_v1_bond`

One row per bond between two potentials (doc 08 §3.7). The whole view is a Preview addition.

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | the bond UUID | yes |
| `label` | TEXT | B1, B2, … in the partition's bond order | yes |
| `kind` | TEXT | the bond kind (pelv_0v_pe, …) | yes |
| `a_potential_id` | TEXT | the potential at end a | yes |
| `a_potential_name` | TEXT | its name | yes |
| `b_potential_id` | TEXT | the potential at end b | yes |
| `b_potential_name` | TEXT | its name | yes |
| `wire_id` | TEXT | the physical wire realising the bond; NULL without one | yes |
| `names` | TEXT | the interruption-point names on the bond path, JSON array in natural order | yes |
| `pages` | TEXT | the folios of the bond wire's pages in page order, JSON array | yes |

## `api_v1_cable`

One row per cable.

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | the cable device UUID |  |
| `tag` | TEXT | the list form of the cable's tag ("-106W1") |  |
| `tag_full` | TEXT | the full designation | yes |
| `part_number` | TEXT | the part number of the cable's part; NULL without one |  |
| `cores` | INTEGER | the number of conductors |  |
| `length_nm` | INTEGER | the manual length; NULL otherwise |  |
| `length_source` | TEXT | manual, part or missing |  |
| `from_location` | TEXT | the location aspect of end A; NULL until derived |  |
| `to_location` | TEXT | the location aspect of end B; NULL until derived |  |
| `end_a` | TEXT | the devices at the From ends of its cores, a terminal standing for its strip, JSON array in natural order | yes |
| `end_b` | TEXT | the devices at the To ends of its cores, JSON array in natural order | yes |
| `external_end` | INTEGER | 1 when a core wire ends at an external point |  |
| `shield` | INTEGER | 1 when the cable has a shield conductor |  |
| `pages` | TEXT | the folios of the cable's representations in page order, JSON array |  |

## `api_v1_device`

One row per device (strips, terminals and cables included).

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | the device UUID |  |
| `tag` | TEXT | the list form of the tag ("-101F1", "-X1031:1"); NULL for a device without one |  |
| `tag_full` | TEXT | the full designation ("=P01+J-E-2416-101F1") |  |
| `letter` | TEXT | the letter code of the tag spec |  |
| `counter` | INTEGER | the stored counter; NULL when unnumbered |  |
| `frozen` | INTEGER | 1 for a frozen tag |  |
| `kind` | TEXT | the device kind (psu, terminal, …); NULL without one |  |
| `parent_id` | TEXT | the parent device; NULL without one |  |
| `structure_function` | TEXT | the function aspect of the device ("=P01"); NULL without one |  |
| `structure_location` | TEXT | the location aspect of the device ("+J-E-2416"); NULL without one |  |
| `function_text` | TEXT | the function text, neutral text; NULL when empty |  |
| `function_text_ml` | TEXT | the function text, JSON of all languages; NULL when empty | yes |
| `process_tag` | TEXT | the process tag; NULL without one |  |
| `state` | TEXT | the lifecycle state as authored (used, spare, reserved, not_fitted) |  |
| `main_page_id` | TEXT | the page of the main representation; NULL when not drawn |  |
| `main_folio` | TEXT | the folio of the main representation; NULL when not drawn |  |
| `main_cell` | TEXT | the frame cell of the main representation ("B8"); NULL without one |  |
| `has_part` | INTEGER | 1 when the device has a part |  |
| `manufacturer` | TEXT | the manufacturer of the main part; NULL without a part |  |
| `part_number` | TEXT | the part number of the main part; NULL without a part |  |
| `tech_data` | TEXT | the technical data as printed ("6 A, C"); NULL without any |  |
| `aspects` | TEXT | the typed aspects, JSON array ("strip", "terminal", "cable") |  |
| `placed` | INTEGER | 1 when placed in a panel layout; NULL until panel layout is derived (1.0) |  |

## `api_v1_function`

One row per function (interruption points included).

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | the function UUID |  |
| `device_id` | TEXT | the device; NULL for an interruption point |  |

## `api_v1_message`

One row per finding of the projection's check run (open and waived).

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fingerprint` | TEXT | the 128-bit fingerprint, 32 lowercase hex digits (FR-CHK-044) |  |
| `rule` | TEXT | the rule ID ("EW-CORE-033") |  |
| `pack` | TEXT | the rule pack |  |
| `pack_version` | TEXT | the pack version; NULL until packs are versioned |  |
| `severity` | TEXT | info, warning or error (the scheme's effective severity) |  |
| `mode` | TEXT | the check mode of the run (release, online) |  |
| `state` | TEXT | open or waived |  |
| `target_ids` | TEXT | the target records, JSON array of UUIDs, the primary target first |  |
| `target_tags` | TEXT | the subject as printed (a derived tag or a name) |  |
| `page_id` | TEXT | the page the finding is shown on; NULL without one |  |
| `cell` | TEXT | the frame cell; NULL until findings carry a position |  |
| `message` | TEXT | the message in English |  |
| `args` | TEXT | the discriminator that tells findings over the same targets apart |  |
| `waiver_id` | TEXT | the waiver of a waived finding; NULL otherwise |  |

## `api_v1_meta`

One row per the projection (one row).

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rev` | INTEGER | the model revision the projection was built from |  |
| `generation` | INTEGER | the store generation the project was opened at; NULL for a model without a store |  |
| `format` | TEXT | the project format version ("1") |  |
| `derivation_profile` | TEXT | the derivation profile version of the project |  |
| `ew_version` | TEXT | the version of the program that built the projection |  |
| `languages` | TEXT | the project languages, JSON array of BCP 47 tags |  |
| `as_of` | TEXT | the date of the release context; NULL without one |  |
| `api_status` | TEXT | "preview": api_v1 is Preview until the 1.0 freeze (ADR-0017 amendment 2); columns may still be added | yes |
| `preview_additions` | TEXT | the views and columns beyond doc 17 §6.1, JSON array of "view" or "view.column" (PREVIEW_ADDITIONS) | yes |

## `api_v1_page`

One row per page in page order, dividers and generated report pages included.

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | the page UUID; a divider page has its section's UUID, a generated page its v5 page ID |  |
| `physical_index` | INTEGER | the 0-based position in the page order |  |
| `folio` | TEXT | the printed folio label ("101", "901.1") |  |
| `number` | INTEGER | the folio number | yes |
| `label` | TEXT | the stored folio label of an authored page ("101a"); NULL otherwise |  |
| `section_id` | TEXT | the section UUID; NULL for front matter | yes |
| `kind` | TEXT | the page type (schematic, section_divider, report, …) |  |
| `title` | TEXT | the page title (TOC title), neutral text |  |
| `title_ml` | TEXT | the page title, JSON of all languages | yes |
| `description` | TEXT | the title-block description override of the page; NULL without one |  |
| `description_overridden` | INTEGER | 1 when the page overrides the project description |  |
| `structure_function` | TEXT | the function aspect of the page ("=P01"); NULL without one |  |
| `structure_location` | TEXT | the location aspect of the page ("+J-E-2416"); NULL without one |  |
| `prev_folio` | TEXT | the folio of the previous page; NULL on the first |  |
| `next_folio` | TEXT | the folio of the next page; NULL on the last |  |
| `generated` | INTEGER | 1 for a generated report page |  |
| `report_block_id` | TEXT | the report block of a generated page; NULL otherwise |  |

## `api_v1_potential`

One row per potential (doc 08 §3).

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | the potential ID: its minimum definition UUID, else its minimum member CP ID |  |
| `name` | TEXT | the canonical name |  |
| `aliases` | TEXT | the other interruption-point names on the potential, JSON array in natural order |  |
| `ptype` | TEXT | the potential's own type ("L+", "M", "PE"); NULL without one |  |
| `voltage` | TEXT | the potential's own voltage in V, exact decimal text; NULL without one |  |
| `ac_dc` | TEXT | ac or dc; NULL without one |  |
| `circuit_class` | TEXT | mains, control, analogue, bus or PE; NULL without one |  |
| `colour` | TEXT | the profile's default colour for the potential: the effective colour of its first wire that takes it from the profile or a definition |  |
| `colour_iec` | TEXT | that colour when every code is an IEC 60757 code; NULL otherwise | yes |
| `default_csa` | TEXT | the profile's default cross-section, exact decimal text |  |
| `default_csa_unit` | TEXT | mm², AWG or kcmil | yes |
| `switched` | INTEGER | 1 when functionally switched (doc 08 §3.6) |  |
| `protected_by_device_id` | TEXT | the device of the nearest upstream protective function; NULL without one |  |
| `protected_by_tag` | TEXT | that device's tag |  |
| `protected_by_cp` | TEXT | the CP of the protective function on this potential's side ("Out1"), when it is the direct upstream pair; NULL otherwise |  |
| `bond_ids` | TEXT | the bonds joining this potential to another, JSON array of UUIDs |  |
| `bus_cable_ids` | TEXT | the cables of the potential's bus lines (`Bus` connections with a cable, FR-CBL-008), JSON array of UUIDs; a bus line takes its colour and size from them (doc 20 §7.3 "(cable)") | yes |
| `member_count` | INTEGER | device CPs (a terminal once) and external points on the potential (doc 20 §7.3) |  |
| `pages` | TEXT | the folios of its wires' pages in page order, JSON array |  |

## `api_v1_terminal`

One row per terminal.

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | the terminal device UUID |  |
| `tag` | TEXT | the list form of the terminal's tag ("-X1031:1") | yes |
| `strip_id` | TEXT | the strip |  |
| `strip_tag` | TEXT | the list form of the strip's tag ("-X1031") |  |
| `designation` | TEXT | the terminal designation ("1", "PE") |  |
| `printed` | TEXT | the designation as printed on the terminal marker |  |
| `seq` | INTEGER | the position on the strip |  |
| `function_text` | TEXT | the terminal's function text ("1+"); NULL when empty | yes |
| `strip_group` | TEXT | the caption of the strip group holding the terminal ("Pneumatics"); NULL outside a group | yes |
| `part_number` | TEXT | the part number of the terminal's part; NULL without one |  |
| `levels` | INTEGER | the number of levels |  |
| `potential_id` | TEXT | the potential of its first connected CP; NULL without one |  |
| `potential_name` | TEXT | that potential's name |  |
| `potential_type` | TEXT | that potential's type ("L+", "PE"); NULL without one |  |
| `state` | TEXT | spare, reserved or not fitted as authored, else used (wired or bridged) or unused |  |
| `bridge` | TEXT | the label of the bridge the terminal belongs to ("BR1"); NULL without one | yes |
| `rail_bonded` | INTEGER | 1 when the terminal is bonded to the rail |  |
| `page_id` | TEXT | the page of its main representation; NULL when not drawn |  |
| `cell` | TEXT | the frame cell of its main representation; NULL without one |  |

## `api_v1_wire`

One row per physical wire or terminal bridge (doc 08 §3.8, §6.5).

| Column | Type | Description | Preview addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | the wire UUID (its carrier connection); for a bridge the strip UUID and group ("&lt;uuid>/bridge/&lt;n>") |  |
| `seq` | INTEGER | the order of the wire list: wires in the numbering order of FR-NUM-028 (doc 08 §5.2), then bridges by label | yes |
| `number` | TEXT | the printed wire number ("101.1", `wire_numbers`; NULL for a cable core); a bridge's label "BR1" |  |
| `kind` | TEXT | wire or bridge |  |
| `from_end` | TEXT | device, external or open | yes |
| `from_device_id` | TEXT | the device at the From end; NULL for an external or open end |  |
| `from_tag` | TEXT | the list form of that device's tag |  |
| `from_cp` | TEXT | the CP designation at the From end |  |
| `from_level` | INTEGER | the terminal level at the From end; NULL without one |  |
| `from_clamp` | TEXT | the terminal clamp at the From end ("a"); NULL without one |  |
| `from_side` | INTEGER | the terminal side at the From end (1 or 2); NULL without one | yes |
| `from_ip` | TEXT | the interruption point an external or open end ends at; NULL for a device end | yes |
| `to_end` | TEXT | device, external or open | yes |
| `to_device_id` | TEXT | the device at the To end; NULL for an external or open end |  |
| `to_tag` | TEXT | the list form of that device's tag |  |
| `to_cp` | TEXT | the CP designation at the To end |  |
| `to_level` | INTEGER | the terminal level at the To end; NULL without one |  |
| `to_clamp` | TEXT | the terminal clamp at the To end; NULL without one |  |
| `to_side` | INTEGER | the terminal side at the To end (1 or 2); NULL without one | yes |
| `to_ip` | TEXT | the interruption point an external or open end ends at; NULL for a device end | yes |
| `potential_id` | TEXT | the potential; NULL for a bond wire |  |
| `potential_name` | TEXT | the potential's name; "A ⇄ B" for a bond wire |  |
| `csa` | TEXT | the effective cross-section, exact decimal text |  |
| `csa_unit` | TEXT | mm², AWG or kcmil |  |
| `colour` | TEXT | the effective colour as printed ("DBU", "GNYE") |  |
| `colour_iec` | TEXT | the colour when every code is an IEC 60757 code; NULL otherwise |  |
| `wire_part` | TEXT | the part number of the wire part; NULL without one |  |
| `length_nm` | INTEGER | the wire length; NULL until lengths are derived (1.0) |  |
| `length_source` | TEXT | where the length comes from; NULL until lengths are derived (1.0) |  |
| `cable_id` | TEXT | the cable of a core wire; NULL otherwise |  |
| `cable_tag` | TEXT | the list form of that cable's tag |  |
| `core` | TEXT | the core name of a core wire ("BN") |  |
| `conductor_id` | TEXT | the conductor of a core wire | yes |
| `bond_id` | TEXT | the bond a bond wire realises; NULL otherwise | yes |
| `ips` | TEXT | the interruption points the wire passes, JSON array of names in path order | yes |
| `junction_id` | TEXT | the first junction the wire passes (doc 08 §3.2); NULL otherwise | yes |
| `junction_style` | TEXT | that junction's style: dot or bevel ("junction" for a newer style); NULL without a junction | yes |
| `junction_wiring` | TEXT | its effective wiring: star or chain (the style's default when unset); NULL without a junction | yes |
| `junction_cell` | TEXT | its folio and frame cell ("101-C11"; the folio alone outside the drawing area); NULL without a junction | yes |
| `junction_cps` | TEXT | star: the entering CP; chain: the wire's ends shared with another wire of the junction; JSON array of CP texts ("F55:2", "-102G1:−#1": `#n` where printed designations repeat) | yes |
| `chain_cps` | TEXT | the wire's ends on a CP that two or more drawn connections touch (a daisy chain, FR-CON-006), JSON array of CP texts | yes |
| `bridge_kind` | TEXT | plug-in, saddle, wire or inter-level for a bridge; NULL for a wire | yes |
| `pages` | TEXT | the folios of the wire's pages in page order, JSON array |  |
| `csa_source` | TEXT | where the cross-section comes from: cdp, core, rule, bond, potential, project, built-in | yes |
| `colour_source` | TEXT | where the colour comes from: cdp, core, rule, potential, project, built-in | yes |
| `prov_csa` | TEXT | the provenance of the cross-section in words |  |
| `prov_colour` | TEXT | the provenance of the colour in words |  |
